〓오늘의 요리는 “묵은지볶음”입니다〓
명절이 지나면 제일 먼저 찾게되는 우리집반찬 1위입니다.

✅총각무된장지짐
[재료]
총각무(묵은지모두 가능)600g
국멸치40g

[양념]
쌀뜨물5컵(1,000ml)
집된장1큰술
식용유2큰술
들기름2큰술
마늘1큰술
대파2큰술(30g)
매실액3큰술
통깨약간
※양념중 들기름대신 참기름으로 대체가능하며,
    매실액대신 올리고당/설탕으로 대체가능하며, 단맛은 기호에 맞게
    맞춥니다.

[묵은지 짠맛/신맛 우려내기]
미지근한물10컵(2,000ml)
설탕1큰술

✅묵은지볶음
[재료]
묵은지1/2포기(양념제거/머리떼고/물기살짝짜준후)610g

[묵은지밑간]
식용유2큰술
마늘1큰술반
대파흰부분한뼘정도(20g)
시판용재래된장1/2큰술

[묵은지볶을때양념]
들기름2큰술
멸치다시마육수1컵반(300ml)
찹쌀가루1/2큰술
비정제설탕(원당)납짝하게1큰술

[마무리양념]
들기름1큰술
후추톡톡3번
통깨약간

〓양념계량기준 〓
🥛계량컵200ml
🥄밥수저(큰술)
☕커피수저(티스푼)

📢이 콘텐츠는 ✔양장금주부에서 제작되었으며,해당 콘텐츠와 레시피는 양장금주부채널에서 저작권 보호를 받고 있습니다. 양장금주부채널 콘텐츠의 저작물을 동의없이 무단으로 복사/침해할 경우 저작권법에 의해 처벌 대상이 될 수 있습니다.

snippet.description:

양파반개

버전으로 만들어 봤습니다.

snippet.description:
양장금주부 가족여러분 오늘도 좋은일만~🍀

〓오늘의 요리는 “절이지않는 무생채”입니다〓
그냥 무치면 물이 홍수인 무생채를 지금까지 소금에 절여서 무쳤다면
이번 명절엔 소금에 절이는과정대신 이렇게 해보세요
과하지않는 물생김으로 충분히 그냥 무쳐도 됩니다

[재료]
무1개(2키로)
쪽파13줄(60g)

[양념]
고춧가루7큰술(70g)
다진새우젓듬뿍2큰술(60g)
마늘2큰술
생강1/3큰술
올리고당2큰술
가는소금납짝하게1큰술반

Dear Housewife Yang Jang-geum family, may you have only good things happen today ~🍀

〓Today's dish is “Braised Shishito Peppers”〓

Summer shishito peppers are too spicy~ Now is when they taste the best. Try braising them with dried anchovies, which are a must, and add this ingredient as well. Even family members who used to be picky about side dishes will polish off a whole bowl of rice in no time.

[Seasoning]

4 tablespoons soup soy sauce

1 tablespoon tuna extract

1 tablespoon garlic

1 flat tablespoon unrefined sugar (raw sugar)

3 tablespoons cooking wine (mirin)

1 tablespoon oligosaccharide

1 tablespoon perilla oil (sesame oil)

Whole sesame seeds

〓Seasoning Measurement Standards〓

🥛Measuring cup 200ml

🥄Table spoon (tablespoon)

These days, there is an abundance of lettuce—so much so that it's almost overwhelming. Here are recipes for Lettuce Salad and Lettuce Pancakes, perfect for enjoying deliciously when you have plenty of lettuce!

en-US.description:
To the Janggeum Housewife family, may you have only good things happen today! 🍀

〓Today's dish is "Cucumber Rice Balls"〓

When you have no appetite or are worried about side dishes, a quick meal is solved with just cucumbers!

Cucumber rice balls are easy to make but so delicious that people are raving about them, saying they taste great even if you eat them every day.

For an even more delicious way to enjoy them, dip them in Japanese mustard sauce—it's absolutely killer.

[Ingredients]

2 cucumbers (seeds removed) 300g

2 bowls of cooked rice 400g

2 packets of seasoned seaweed

[1st Pickling of Cucumbers]

2/3 teaspoon fine salt

[2nd Pickling of Cucumbers]

2/3 tablespoon sugar

2 1/2 tablespoons vinegar

[Rice Seasoning]

1 teaspoon seasoned salt

1 tablespoon perilla oil

2 tablespoons ground whole sesame seeds (heaping)

[Yeon Mustard Sauce]

1 tablespoon dark soy sauce

1 tablespoon oligosaccharide

1/2 tablespoon vinegar

1/2 teaspoon Yeon Mustard

〓Seasoning Measurement Standards〓

🥛Measuring cup 200ml

🥄Rice spoon (tablespoon)

☕Coffee spoon (teaspoon)

Saat Anda tidak nafsu makan atau khawatir tentang lauk piring, hidangan cepat dapat diselesaikan hanya dengan timun!

Bola nasi timun mudah dibuat tetapi sangat lezat sehingga orang-orang memujinya, mengatakan rasanya enak bahkan jika Anda memakannya setiap hari.

1 sendok teh garam berbumbu

en-US.title: 💙These days, I eat tofu like this ✔ so I don't have to worry about side dishes💯
en-US.description:
Good luck to all the Yangjanggeum family members today~🍀

〓Today's recipe is "Two Tofu Dishes"〓
Our family has been enjoying tofu so much lately!
This tofu dish kills two birds with one stone: it reduces the worry of side dishes and can even be used as a meal replacement for weight loss.

✅Dubu Duruchigi
★Correction~
The video incorrectly stated 1 cup of anchovy kelp broth equals 100ml.

1 cup equals 200ml~^^

[Ingredients]
1 block of tofu for pan-frying (300g)
1/2 onion (80g)
3 Cheongyang peppers
1/2 can of Spam (100g)
1 green onion
1 tbsp cooking oil
1 tbsp perilla oil

[Seasoning]
1 cup of anchovy kelp broth (200ml)
1 tbsp gochujang (red pepper paste)
2 tbsp red pepper powder
2 tbsp tuna fish sauce (alternative seasoning - anchovy fish sauce or soy sauce can be substituted)
1 tbsp garlic
1 tbsp shaved sugar (alternative seasoning - grain syrup or oligosaccharide can be substituted)
A pinch of pepper

✅Diet Tofu Rice
[Ingredients]
2/3 block of tofu for pan-frying (200g)
1 egg
20g paprika
20g carrot
30g onion
15g green onion

[Seasoning]
1 tbsp cooking oil
1 1/2 tbsp perilla oil
2 pinches fine salt
1/2 tbsp oyster sauce
A pinch of sesame seeds
A pinch of pepper

〓Seasoning Measurements 〓
🥛Measuring cup 200ml
🥄Rice spoon (tbsp)
☕Coffee spoon (tsp)

[마무리양념]

후추톡톡3번
통깨약간

양장금주부 가족여러분 오늘도 좋은일만~🍀

〓오늘의 요리는 “소갈비찜 vs 돼지갈비찜”입니다〓
온가족이 모이는 명절에 고급한정식집에서 먹던 그 맛으로 소갈비찜,돼지갈비찜을 
쉽게 만들어 보세요.느끼하지않고 텁텁하지않고 깔끔해서 명절때마다 극찬을 받는
갈비찜레시피입니다.

✅소갈비찜
[재료]
소갈비1.5kg
고구마작은것1개(120g)
당근작은것1개(80g)
청양고추3개
청양건고추5개

[채수재료]
생수7컵(1,400ml)
무1토막(160g)
양파1/2개(130g)
대파흰부분1뿌리(90g)
사과1/2개(180g)
생강1톨(10g)

[조림육수]
채수3컵(600ml)
진간장9큰술
마늘1큰술반
흑설탕2큰술반
소양념갈비소스2큰술반
들기름1큰술반
후추약간

[고기초벌삶기]
소추1컵(200ml)

[고기핏물빼기]
고기가 잠길만큼의 찬물
설탕1큰술

[고기압력밥솥에찌기]
생수3컵(600ml)
맛술1/4컵(50ml)
월계수잎2장

✅돼지갈비찜
[재료]
돼지갈비1.5kg
당근중간크기1개
밤10알
홍고추작은것5개
청양고추3개

[채수]
대파1뿌리
양파반개
무140g
생강6g
통마늘8알
당근돌려까기한자투리

[돼지갈비초벌삶기]
월계수잎3장
통후추약간
포도주50ml
매실액50ml

[양념]
채수800ml
진간장12큰술
조청7큰술
양념갈비소스4큰술
카라멜소스2/3큰술
들기름2큰술
후추약간
통깨약간

〓양념계량기준 〓
🥛계량컵200ml
🥄밥수저(큰술)
☕커피수저(티스푼)

📢이 콘텐츠는 ✔양장금주부에서 제작되었으며,해당 콘텐츠와 레시피는 양장금주부채널에서 저작권 보호를 받고 있습니다. 양장금주부채널 콘텐츠의 저작물을 동의없이 무단으로 복사/침해할 경우 저작권법에 의해 처벌 대상이 될 수 있습니다.

en-US.title: 💙Make it with the ✔short rib stew (pork rib stew) that you used to eat at a high-end Korean resta...
en-US.description:
Good luck to all the Yangjanggeum family members today~🍀

〓Today's recipe is "Short Rib Stew vs. Pork Rib Stew."〓
Easily make beef rib stew and pork rib stew with the same flavor you'd find at a fancy Korean restaurant during the holidays when the whole family gathers. This short rib stew recipe is raved about every holiday because it's not greasy or heavy, but rather clean.

✅Steamed Beef Short Ribs
[Ingredients]
1.5 kg beef short ribs
1 small sweet potato (120 g)
1 small carrot (80 g)
3 Cheongyang peppers
5 Cheongyang dried peppers

[Vegetable Ingredients]
7 cups water (1,400 ml)
1 slice radish (160 g)
1/2 onion (130 g)
1 white part of green onion (90 g)
1/2 apple (180 g)
1 clove of ginger (10 g)

[Braising Broth]
3 cups vegetable stock (600 ml)
9 tablespoons soy sauce
1 1/2 tablespoons garlic
2 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar
2 1/2 tablespoons beef short rib sauce
1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil
A pinch of pepper

[Pre-boiling the meat]
1 cup (200 ml) beef short ribs

[Draining the blood from the meat]
Enough water to cover the meat Cold water
1 tablespoon sugar

[Pressure Cooker Meat]
3 cups (600 ml) of water
1/4 cup (50 ml) of cooking wine
2 bay leaves

✅Braised Pork Ribs
[Ingredients]
1.5 kg of pork ribs
1 medium carrot
10 chestnuts
5 small red peppers
3 Cheongyang peppers

[Vegetables]
1 green onion
1/2 onion
140 g radish
6 g ginger g
8 whole garlic cloves
1 carrot, peeled and sliced

[Pre-boiling pork ribs]
3 bay leaves
A pinch of whole pepper
50 ml wine
50 ml plum extract

[Seasoning]
800 ml vegetable stock
12 tablespoons soy sauce
7 tablespoons grain syrup
4 tablespoons marinated rib sauce
2/3 tablespoons caramel sauce
2 tablespoons perilla oil
A pinch of pepper
A pinch of sesame seeds

〓Seasoning Measurements 〓
🥛Measuring cup 200 ml
🥄Rice spoon (tablespoon)
☕Coffee spoon (teaspoon)

snippet.title: 💙명절 배추겉절이는 절이거나 풀쑤지마세요!대신 ✔이걸로 해결됩니다💯
snippet.description:
양장금주부 가족여러분 오늘도 좋은일만~🍀

〓오늘의 요리는 “알배추겉절이”입니다〓
명절에 빠르게 먹는 알배추겉절이는 절이거나 풀을쑤지않아도 양념 착착붙고
입에 짝짝붙는 겉절이로 만들수 있어요.번거롭고 힘들게 하지말고 쉽고 간단하지만
맛있는 배추겉절이 만들어보세요.

[재료]
알배추2통(다듬은후)1.1kg
쪽파한줌 80g
사과1/4쪽(50g)
양파1/4쪽(50g)

[양념]
고춧가루듬뿍7큰술(70g)
마늘1큰술반
생강납짝하게1/2큰술
올리고당1큰술반
새우젓1큰술(30g)
멸치액젓4큰술
통깨솔솔~

〓양념계량기준 〓
🥛계량컵200ml
🥄밥수저(큰술)
☕커피수저(티스푼)

📢이 콘텐츠는 ✔양장금주부에서 제작되었으며,해당 콘텐츠와 레시피는 양장금주부채널에서 저작권 보호를 받고 있습니다. 양장금주부채널 콘텐츠의 저작물을 동의없이 무단으로 복사/침해할 경우 저작권법에 의해 처벌 대상이 될 수 있습니다.

en-US.title: 💙Don't pickle or soak the pickled cabbage for the holidays! Instead, ✔this will solve the problem💯
en-US.description:
Good luck to all the Yangjanggeum family members today~🍀

〓Today's recipe is "Baechu Geotjeori" (Korean Cabbage Pickles)〓
Baechu Geotjeori, a quick holiday dish, is made without pickling or seasoning. It's a delicious, savory dish that's perfectly seasoned and delicious. Don't sweat the hassle. Try making this simple, yet delicious, cabbage pickle.

[Ingredients]

2 heads of cabbage (trimmed) 1.1kg
1 handful of green onions 80g
1/4 apple (50g)
1/4 onion (50g)

[Seasoning]
7 tablespoons (70g) of red pepper powder
1 1/2 tablespoons of garlic
1/2 tablespoon of finely chopped ginger
1 1/2 tablespoons of oligosaccharide
1 tablespoon (30g) of salted shrimp
4 tablespoons of anchovy sauce
Spiked sesame seeds

〓Seasoning Measurements 〓
🥛Measuring cup 200ml
🥄Rice spoon (tablespoon)
☕Coffee spoon (teaspoon)

en-US.title: 💙Same Japchae, ✔Just a different method! Popular every holiday💯
en-US.description:
Dear Yang Jang-geum family, have a wonderful day today!🍀

〓Today's recipe is "Two Kinds of Japchae"〓
I made two versions: ✔Simple and Easy Japchae, which is easy to make every day, and ✔Full of Toppings Japchae, which is considered a luxurious and high-quality dish served on a royal table on special occasions like holidays.

✅ Simple Japchae that's never simple in taste
[Ingredients]
300g glass noodles
120g spinach
1/2 red bell pepper
1/2 yellow bell pepper
100g carrot
1/2 onion (120g)
120g oyster mushrooms
3 Cheongyang peppers
200g japchae beef

[Seasoning]
8 tbsp soy sauce
4 tbsp mirin
4 tbsp rice syrup
5 toasts of black pepper

[For stir-frying paprika, spinach, onion, and carrots]
3 tbsp cooking oil
1/2 tbsp garlic
Fine salt 1 teaspoon flat

[For stir-frying beef/oyster mushrooms/Cheongyang peppers]
1 tablespoon cooking oil
1/2 tablespoon garlic
3 tablespoons prepared seasoning sauce

[For boiling glass noodles]
4 cups water (800ml)
3 tablespoons soy sauce
3 tablespoons brown sugar
3 tablespoons chili oil

[For stir-frying after boiling glass noodles]
Prepared seasoning sauce
2 tablespoons sesame oil

[Final seasoning]
2 tablespoons perilla oil
Plenty of sesame seeds

✅A king's table full of sincerity Japchae
[Ingredients]
300g glass noodles
1 red bell pepper (with the core removed) 80g
3 shiitake mushrooms (with the core removed and blanched) 120g
200g beef for japchae
2 green cucumbers (with the core removed) 160g
150g bellflower roots

[Seasoned cucumbers]
1/3 tablespoon fine salt

[To remove the bitterness from the bellflower roots]
1 tablespoon sea salt
1 tablespoon sugar
1/4 cup water (50ml)
To remove the additional bitterness - plenty of warm water

[To stir-fry ingredients]
For stir-frying cucumbers - 1/2 tablespoon cooking oil
For stir-frying onions and bellflower roots - 1 tablespoon cooking oil 2 pinches of fine salt
For stir-frying red bell peppers: 1/2 tablespoon cooking oil, 1 pinch of fine salt

en-US.description:
Dear Yangjanggeum family, I hope you have a wonderful day today~🍀

〓Today's recipe is "Raw Radish Salad without Pickling"〓
If you've been salting raw radish salad, which is watery when simply seasoned,
this holiday season, try this instead of salting.
You can season it just right, as it's not too watery.

[Ingredients]
1 radish (2 kg)
13 green onions (60 g)

[Seasoning]
7 tbsp red pepper powder (70 g)
2 tbsp minced shrimp paste (60 g)
2 tbsp garlic
1/3 tbsp ginger
2 tbsp oligosaccharide
1 1/2 tbsp fine salt
※Winter radishes have a good moisture and sweetness, but each radish can vary greatly, so adjust the sweetness and saltiness to your personal taste.

〓Seasoning Measurements 〓
🥛Measuring Cup 200ml
🥄Rice Spoon (Tablespoon)

snippet.title: 💙명절때마다 고민없이 만드는 밑반찬!이거하나면 끝💯
snippet.description:
양장금주부 가족여러분 오늘도 좋은일만~🍀

〓오늘의 요리는 “명절밑반찬2가지”입니다〓
명절밑반찬중 느끼한 명절음식과 너무 잘어울리는 초무침2가지입니다.
진미채를 중심으로 도라지와오이를 곁들여 새콤달콤하게 무쳐내는
새콤달콤한 진미채도라지초무침과 진미채오이초무침 명절밑반찬으로 필수입니다.

[재료]
도라지200g
진미채100g
대파흰부분1/2뿌리

[양념]
진간장2큰술
멸치액젓1큰술
고추장1/2큰술
고추가루4큰술
올리고당1큰술
식초4큰술
마늘듬뿍1큰술
설탕깍아서1/2큰술
통깨약간

[오이절임]
꽃소금깍아서1티스푼
설탕깍아서1티스푼
※5분간 절임합니다.

[도라지쓴물빼기]
약간의물
설탕2큰술

[진미채비린맛제거]
맛술(미림)2큰술
※끓는 찜통에 넣어 5분간 쪄줍니다.

오이2개(350g)
양파작은것1개(90g)
진미채50g
맛술1큰술

[양념]

통깨약간

These are two kimchi salads that pair perfectly with rich holiday dishes.

en-US.title: 💢You don't need anything else for ordinary bean sprout stir-fry (steamed bean sprouts) ✔Just one ...
en-US.description:
Wishing you all the best today, Yangjanggeum family! 🍀

〓Today's recipe is "Stir-fried Bean Sprouts (Steamed Bean Sprouts)." 〓
A miraculous spoonful of bean sprout stew so delicious that one bag of bean sprouts won't be enough! No need for fancy ingredients. Be sure to try this simple and easy-to-make bean sprout stir-fry.

[Ingredients]
1 bag of bean sprouts (300g)
100g water parsley
1/2 white part of green onion (35g)
1/2 onion (80g)
2 Cheongyang peppers

[Perilla powder water]
1 tbsp perilla powder (15g)
1/3 tbsp potato starch (5g)
3 tbsp water

[Seasoning]
2 tbsp red pepper powder
2 1/2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp tuna extract
1/2 tbsp garlic
1 tbsp oligosaccharide
2/3 tbsp sesame oil
5 pinches of pepper
A pinch of sesame seeds

〓Seasoning Measurements 〓
🥛Measuring cup 200ml
🥄Rice spoon (1 tbsp)
☕Coffee spoon (1 tsp)

en-US.title: 💢There's no rice thief like this these days❗If you cook it like this, everyone will recognize it💯
en-US.description:
Dear Yangjanggeumjubu family, have a great day today~🍀

〓Today's recipe is "Kimchi Jjigae (Jjageul-i)"〓
Kimchi Jjigae (Jjageul-i) made with aged kimchi is a delicious way to use fresh kimchi when you don't have any side dishes or don't have an appetite!

✅Spicy Kimchi Tofu Jjagalbi
[Ingredients]
1 block of tofu (200g)
200g ground pork
100g spicy kimchi
1/2 green onion (30g)
1/2 onion (160g)
2 Cheongyang peppers

[Seasoning]
1.5 cups anchovy and kelp broth (300ml)
1 tbsp gochujang (red pepper paste)
2 tbsp red pepper powder
1 tbsp garlic
2 tbsp anchovy sauce
1/2 tbsp sugar

[Meat/Kimchi Stir-fry Seasoning]
2 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp soy sauce
Garlic 1/2 tbsp
2 tbsp mirin
A pinch of pepper

✅Pork Kimchi Stew
[Ingredients]
400g pork shoulder
1/4 slice of sour kimchi (450g)
1/4 slice of onion (30g)
1/2 root of green onion (30g)

[Seasoning]
900ml anchovy kelp broth
1 tbsp salted shrimp
2 tbsp mirin
1/2 tbsp sugar
1/2 tbsp garlic
2 tbsp red pepper powder
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp anchovy sauce (for final seasoning) Taste and adjust to your taste.

〓Seasoning Measurement Guidelines〓
🥛Measuring Cup 200ml
🥄Rice Spoon (Tablespoon)
☕Coffee Spoon (Teaspoon)

en-US.title: 💢Refreshing Kimchi Soup ✔Must watch this before boiling!💯
en-US.description:
Dear Yangjanggeumjubu family, I hope you have a great day today~🍀

〓Today's recipe is "Kimchi Soup"〓
Today, I'm sharing two refreshing kimchi soups that are both delicious and nutritious, perfect for cold days, rather than the usual kimchi soup you've been eating.

✅Soybean Powder Kimchi Soup
[Ingredients]
300g fresh kimchi
5 tbsp raw soybean powder
1/2 root green part of green onion (40g)

[Seasoning]
5 cups anchovy kelp broth (1,000ml)
3/4 cup strained kimchi broth (150ml)
1/2 tbsp garlic
1 tbsp red pepper powder
1 tbsp anchovy sauce
1/2 tbsp sugar
A pinch of pepper

✅Soft Tofu Kimchi Soup
[Ingredients]
Sun 1 pack of tofu (400g)
A small amount of glass noodles (smaller than a 500-won coin)
200g of fresh kimchi
1/2 green onion

[Seasoning]
1,200ml anchovy and kelp broth
2 tbsp perilla oil
1/2 tbsp garlic
2 tbsp red pepper powder
1/2 cup (100ml) kimchi broth
2 tbsp anchovy sauce
1/2 tbsp shrimp sauce (broth)
A pinch of pepper

〓Seasoning Measurements 〓
🥛Measuring cup 200ml
🥄Rice spoon (tablespoon)
☕Coffee spoon (teaspoon)

〓Today's recipe is "Perilla Leaf Radish Soup"〓
